2610.12061.title: When Should Agents Think? Adaptive Reasoning via Cross-Turn Estimation
2610.12061.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities on complex tasks. They typically perform reasoning before each action throughout an interaction trajectory. However, reasoning may not be necessary at every turn, as reasoning produced earlier can continue to support subsequent actions. A key challenge is therefore to determine when existing reasoning remains sufficient and when a new reasoning step is needed, without relying on costly generation-based verification. We find that decreases in the likelihood of subsequent reference actions after removing additional reasoning closely track whether those actions remain recoverable given earlier reasoning, providing an effective and lightweight signal for estimating cross-turn action support. Based on this observation, we propose Reasoning Adaptation through Cross-Turn Estimation (RACE), a training approach for adaptive agent reasoning. RACE introduces a Likelihood-Guided Progressive Reasoning Cover Detection (LoGiC) procedure that progressively identifies reasoning turns whose removal has limited impact on the current and subsequent reference actions. The resulting removal signals are incorporated into both supervised fine-tuning and agentic reinforcement learning, enabling the policy to learn when to reason and when to act directly. Extensive experiments on four representative agent benchmarks show that RACE substantially reduces reasoning cost while maintaining or improving task performance.
2610.12061.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）基礎的代理在複雜任務上展現了強大的能力。<lb/>它們通常在每次行動之前進行推理，貫穿整個互動過程。<lb/>然而，並非在每個時刻都需要推理，因為早期產生的推理可以繼續支持後續行動。<lb/>因此，一個主要挑戰是確定何時現有的推理仍然足夠，以及何時需要新的推理步驟，而不依賴於成本高昂的生成基礎驗證。<lb/>我們發現，在移除額外推理後，後續參考行動的可能性降低與這些行動在早期推理下是否仍然可恢復密切相關，這提供了一個有效且輕量的信號來估計跨回合行動支持。<lb/>基於這一觀察，我們提出了通過跨回合估計的推理適應（RACE），這是一種用於自適應代理推理的訓練方法。<lb/>RACE 引入了一個可能性引導的漸進推理覆蓋檢測（LoGiC）程序，該程序逐步識別移除其對當前和後續參考行動影響有限的推理回合。<lb/>所產生的移除信號被納入監督微調和代理強化學習中，使政策能夠學習何時進行推理以及何時直接行動。<lb/>在四個具有代表性的代理基準上進行的廣泛實驗顯示，RACE 顯著降低了推理成本，同時保持或改善了任務性能。
